CustomField.description: The engagement link this draft was typed on. Set on both row types since ADR-0008 / backlog D11: the readiness questionnaire is no longer minted from a bare /assessment route -- it is hosted inside gtmConfigurator on /configurator, so an Assessment row now normally has an engagement link, and GtmAssessmentDraftController uses it to build an emailed resume URL that carries ?cfgId= as well as the token. Without it a resumed-from-email submission arrives unlinked: no Opportunity, no Account, no rep attribution, and scored against the default offering rather than the link's own. Still not required -- a standalone or link-less draft legitimately has none, and GtmAssessmentDraftController.asConfigId() degrades an unusable value to null rather than failing the save. GtmFormDraftController's own isLinkWritable() gate is what enforces this on the Booking path.
CustomField.label: Engagement Link
